title: Tier-3 stateful-fuzz harness calls the pre-story-045 5-arg pool(); fails to compile so the reworked split/burn/WBTC flow is not fuzzed
description: The run-16 stateful-fuzz harness (Tier3PromotionInvariants.t.sol) invokes the old 5-argument signature pool(amountIn, 0, 0, 0, 0). story-045 changed PromotionUniV2_Eth.pool to a 6-argument signature (added minWbtcOut for the WBTC insurer-reserve leg). The harness therefore fails to compile, so the Medusa/Foundry invariant campaigns do NOT exercise the reworked split/burn/WBTC value flow. Only the deterministic fork unit tests cover it (which PASS 70/70).
impact: Recall risk (Law-1 adjacent), not a live vulnerability. A stale/non-compiling invariant harness silently drops stateful-fuzz coverage of the exact code story-045 reworked (60/30/10 split, half-phUSD burn, WBTC insurer reserve). This is the vacuous-harness / silent-coverage-gap pattern: a green-looking test suite that no longer exercises the changed path. Deterministic fork unit tests (70/70 pass) plus this run's 4 empirically-confirmed Tier-3 fork invariants provide the actual coverage; the fuzz harness needs a refresh to restore stateful campaigns.
attackPath: No attack path — test-infrastructure coverage gap.
recommendation: Refresh Tier3PromotionInvariants.t.sol to the 6-arg pool(amountIn, minPhusdOut, minPromoOut, minLp, minWbtcOut, ...) signature (match the current story-045 ABI) so the Medusa/Foundry invariant campaigns compile and re-exercise the reworked split/burn/WBTC flow.
